description: The plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across different layers, comparing three distinct scenarios. The x-axis, labeled "Layer", has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 23, and is marked at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Sparsity Ratio", also has a linear scale, spans from 0.0 to 1.0, and is marked at intervals of 0.2. Three lines are depicted: a blue dashed line representing the "sparsity ratio before gate" with an average value of 0.03, which starts at approximately 0.16 at layer 0 and decreases to around 0.01 at layer 23; an orange dotted line representing the "sparsity ratio after gate" with an average value of 0.44, which begins at 1.0 at layer 0, drops to about 0.25 at layer 10, and then fluctuates between 0.2 and 0.5 from layer 10 to 23; and a green dash-dotted line representing the "sparsity ratio after average gate" with an average value of 0.33, which starts at 1.0 at layer 0, decreases to around 0.1 at layer 10, and then remains relatively stable between 0.1 and 0.15 from layer 10 to 20 before dropping to approximately 0.05 at layer 23.
